name: This is...UPW! (debut broadcast)
notes: The broadcast recaps eight untelevised preliminary results (Killer Kadugan def. Super Ninja; Marcus Mantini def. Akira Dragon; Kevin Sanders def. "Rebel" Rex Harley; Carr def. Brin Taylor; Nightmare vs. Senor Chaos, double disqualification; King Richard def. Russianari by count-out; "Superstar" Ken Buagar def. "Destroyer" Doug Dane by submission; Keifer Farlane def. Johans Keprete) as prose only, not structured since they were not shown and are results-only. A live main event (Killer Kadugan vs. Marcus Mantini) begins in the served text; its finish runs into an unserved Part II. UPW's own commentators for this broadcast share names with real-name ledger rows filed for an unrelated 1997 fed, UIW -- flagged as a cross-lane identity coincidence on the coordinator collision sheet, not adjudicated here.
